hints.title: Inverse XOR Property
hints.text: Because a ^ b = c implies b = a ^ c, each successive element can be derived from the previous.

hints.title: Sequential Recovery
hints.text: Initialize the result array with first, then compute arr[i + 1] = arr[i] ^ encoded[i].

hints.title: Single Linear Pass
hints.text: Iterate through encoded from index 0 to n - 1 appending derived values.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: n is length of encoded array
complexity.whyNaiveFails: No naive bottleneck exists; linear derivation is optimal.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Linear scan computes original array in O(n) time and O(n) output array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate applies self-inverting property of bitwise XOR.
